description: Specialist agent roles separated by decision boundary. Registration defines the boundary; docs/AGENT_SPECIALIST_ARCHITECTURE.md explains it. No role approves its own work.

IntakeBrief.description: Reviewed statement of what the owner asked for, before research or specification.

KnowledgePack.description: Trusted normalized source knowledge with provenance.

ResearchPack.description: Bounded evidence about market, competitors, audience and reference products, with confidence and source ids.

ProductDecision.description: Opportunity/assumption/risk decisions taken before a specification is written.

ProductSpec.description: Scope, audiences, jobs, journeys, acceptance criteria and explicit exclusions.

InformationArchitectureSpec.description: Mental model, sitemap, navigation, taxonomy, URL hierarchy, labels and content hierarchy.

UXFlowSpec.description: Task flows, interaction models, loading/empty/error/interruption states and recovery behaviour.

ContentSpec.description: Product/UI copy: labels, validation, onboarding, empty states, confirmations and voice.

MarketingContentSpec.description: Marketing/CRO copy, offers, proof strategy and conversion messaging for public sites.

ArchitectureSpec.description: Technical architecture: data model, auth/tenancy, API contracts, migrations and integration boundaries.

BrandSpec.description: Palette, logo usage, typography intent, imagery/icon language, tone and brand adjectives with confidence and sources.

ArtDirectionPlan.description: Machine-readable visual strategy: layout variance, motion intensity, density, distinctiveness and restraint.

DesignSystemSpec.description: Token, primitive, component, section-family, responsive, motion and accessibility contract.

MotionContract.description: Entrance, scroll, transition, hover/press, stagger, density and reduced-motion rules.

ComponentManifest.description: Structured description of each presentation component so agents retrieve a small relevant set instead of a whole library.

ImagePlan.description: Per-section image jobs with real-vs-generated requirement, candidates, rights and approval state.

ElementIdentityMap.description: Rendered element to page/section/component/instance/binding/provenance identity, with the artifact location, editable properties and design tokens for each. Derived deterministically at generation time from the composition and the template's presentation contract.

TestPlan.description: Test strategy, missing coverage, regression cases and reproduction steps.

RenderedEvidence.description: Browser captures of what a build actually renders, at desktop, tablet and mobile plus the critical interaction states the build has. Visual evidence only: it shows what a state looks like and never proves a journey completes, and every state it cannot establish is recorded as uncovered with the reason.

RuntimeDiagnostics.description: Console errors, network traces, runtime state and performance traces explaining browser behaviour.

DesignLintReport.description: Deterministic visual-defect findings produced before expensive AI critique.

AccessibilityReport.description: Deterministic axe results plus specialist findings that automation cannot establish.

PerformanceReport.description: Measured lab/field performance against declared budgets.

SeoReport.description: Deterministic crawlability/metadata/structured-data findings plus AEO interpretation.

SecurityReport.description: Independent assessment of auth, tenancy, input handling, secrets, storage and deployment boundaries.

ReviewVerdict.description: Independent verdict on one artifact or stage.

StageHandoff.description: Durable promotion record for one stage, written by the control plane rather than by a role.

ConvergenceReport.description: Deterministic gate matrix and rework routing.

ReleaseDecision.description: PASS/BLOCKED release verdict with the evidence it was based on.

ProductOpportunityReport.description: At most three ranked, materially different improvement opportunities for a broad prompt, each grounded in the current implementation. Candidate scope, never approved scope.

StateMatrixSpec.description: The real state axes a capability exposes, impossible combinations removed, remaining states ranked by user risk, with the fixtures and evidence each important state requires.

JourneyClosureEvidence.description: Per-step closure ledger for one user journey: proven complete, deliberately out of scope, blocked, and the exact executable evidence used. A component existing is not closure.

RiskClassification.description: Deterministic classification of a ChangeSet against risk surfaces (auth, authorization, database/schema, RLS, secrets, environment config, file ingestion, SSRF, deployment, provider boundaries, billing, production mutation, cross-layer refactor). Decides whether conditional review is required.

EnvironmentIdentity.description: Machine-readable identity card for an environment-sensitive action: project, target environment, deploy target, repository revision, hosted revision, production revision, mutation authorisation, secret availability, database/migration target and rollback target.

CompoundLearningCandidate.description: One evidence-backed reusable lesson plus the narrowest existing durable home that should hold it. Most completed work produces none.

requirements-interviewer.purpose: Turns rough owner input into an explicit, contradiction-free intake brief before any research or build spend.
mayNot: invent requirements the owner did not state
stopCriteria: all high-impact questions answered or explicitly deferred
intake budget reached

research-agent.purpose: Gathers bounded, cited evidence about the market, competitors, audience and reference products.
mayNot: assert findings without a source and confidence
stopCriteria: research questions answered with cited evidence
research budget reached

product-discovery.purpose: Frames opportunities, assumptions and value/usability/feasibility/viability risks before a specification is committed.
stopCriteria: each major assumption is either evidenced or explicitly flagged as a risk

product-critic.purpose: Independently judges research quality, product decisions and specification completeness.
mayNot: author or edit the artifacts it reviews
stopCriteria: a verdict is issued for every named criterion

product-specification.purpose: Owns scope, audiences, journeys, acceptance criteria and explicit exclusions.
stopCriteria: every journey has acceptance criteria
no unresolved high-impact requirement remains

information-architect.purpose: Owns mental models, sitemap, navigation, taxonomy, URL hierarchy, labels and content hierarchy.
stopCriteria: every required surface has a place in the hierarchy
labels are validated or explicitly assumed

ia-critic.purpose: Independently judges whether the information architecture matches user mental models and product scope.
mayNot: author or edit the information architecture
stopCriteria: a verdict is issued for every named criterion

ux-interaction.purpose: Owns task flows, interaction models, state coverage, recovery and responsive interaction expectations.
mayNot: choose final art direction or typography palette
stopCriteria: loading, empty, error and interruption states exist for every critical flow

ux-critic.purpose: Independently judges flow completeness, recoverability and interaction quality.
stopCriteria: a verdict is issued for every named criterion

ux-writer.purpose: Owns product/UI copy: labels, validation, onboarding, empty states, confirmations and voice.
mayNot: make factual claims beyond trusted knowledge
stopCriteria: every interactive surface named in the UX flows has copy

marketing-content.purpose: Owns marketing/CRO copy, offers, proof strategy and conversion messaging for public sites.
stopCriteria: every claim is source-backed or explicitly marked as generated

brand-research.purpose: Derives BrandSpec from supplied assets, the existing site and approved public profiles, with confidence and rights state.
mayNot: treat publicly visible assets as approved for republication
stopCriteria: each brand signal has a source and confidence
rights state is recorded for every asset

art-direction.purpose: Produces bounded, machine-readable art-direction candidates and the image plan that supports them.
mayNot: edit the design system tokens directly
stopCriteria: between two and four genuinely different candidates exist
each candidate declares its variance, density, motion and distinctiveness values

visual-critic.purpose: Independently judges brand fidelity and art direction against evidence, before any implementation spend.
mayNot: author or edit brand or art direction
stopCriteria: a scored verdict is issued with a capped, prioritised issue set

design-system.purpose: Compiles the approved art direction into a token/primitive/component/motion contract and component manifests.
stopCriteria: every token, component and motion rule the composition needs is defined and compiles

composition.purpose: Composes pages and sections from approved structure, content and design contracts using the presentation registry.
mayNot: invent components outside the presentation registry
stopCriteria: every page in the information architecture is composed
no section bypasses the design system

solution-architect.purpose: Owns data model, auth/tenancy, API contracts, migrations and integration boundaries.
stopCriteria: every entity, role and API boundary in the product spec is covered

frontend-implementation.purpose: Implements composed pages and interactions inside the design system and declared ChangeSet scope.
mayNot: decide whether its own test coverage is sufficient
change design tokens or product scope
stopCriteria: declared acceptance checks pass
iteration or no-progress budget reached

backend-implementation.purpose: Implements data, auth, API and migration work inside the approved architecture and ChangeSet scope.
mayNot: decide whether its own security posture is acceptable
stopCriteria: declared acceptance checks pass
iteration or no-progress budget reached

test-engineer.purpose: Owns test strategy, missing coverage, regression cases and failure reproduction.
mayNot: weaken or skip a test to make a build pass
stopCriteria: every acceptance criterion has an executable check or an explicit gap record

simplification.purpose: Removes accidental complexity after correctness is established, preserving exact behaviour.
stopCriteria: no behaviour-preserving simplification remains, or the diff stops shrinking

code-reviewer.purpose: Independently judges correctness, architecture, API design, maintainability and unintended scope.
stopCriteria: a verdict is issued for every named criterion

browser-qa.purpose: Proves that real journeys, forms, navigation, state transitions and responsive layouts actually work in a browser.
mayNot: explain why the browser behaves as it does
stopCriteria: every acceptance journey has a pass/fail result and captured evidence

runtime-debug.purpose: Explains why the browser behaves as it does using console, network, runtime state and performance traces.
mayNot: declare a journey passing or failing
stopCriteria: a root cause or an explicit unknown is recorded for each investigated symptom

accessibility.purpose: Owns semantics, keyboard operation, focus order, screen-reader logic, zoom/reflow, motion and touch accessibility beyond automated checks.
mayNot: claim automated results equal full compliance
stopCriteria: deterministic results are consumed and manual-review-required findings are named

performance.purpose: Measures against declared budgets, distinguishes lab from field evidence and names actual bottlenecks.
stopCriteria: every declared budget has a measured result

seo-aeo.purpose: Judges crawlability, metadata, structured data, internal linking, service/location evidence and AI-search readiness.
mayNot: invent service areas or locations without evidence
stopCriteria: deterministic scanner findings are consumed and interpreted

security.purpose: Independently assesses auth, authorization, tenancy, input handling, secrets, storage, policies, APIs and deployment boundaries.
mayNot: waive a failed deterministic security gate
stopCriteria: every security-relevant surface in scope has a finding or an explicit clean result

design-critic.purpose: Scores ship readiness of the rendered product against brand, art direction and design system, with a capped prioritised issue set.
mayNot: issue vague aesthetic commentary without grounded evidence
stopCriteria: a scored verdict with at most the configured number of prioritised issues is issued

red-team.purpose: Fresh-context adversarial reviewer: extracts the claims the factory is making and tries to refute them.
mayNot: reuse the conversation context of the work it reviews
stopCriteria: every extracted claim is either reconciled with evidence or recorded as unverified

ship-release.purpose: Collects release evidence and issues PASS or BLOCKED. It never fixes anything.
stopCriteria: every required gate has a recorded result

product-opportunity-scout.purpose: Turns a broad outcome prompt such as "improve this page" into at most three ranked, materially different opportunities grounded in the current implementation.
mayNot: default a broad improvement prompt to visual redesign
invent a second backend or data truth
treat a candidate opportunity as approved scope
manufacture work when the current surface is already strong
stopCriteria: at most three ranked opportunities are recorded, or the report states that no bounded improvement earned its complexity

state-matrix.purpose: Derives the state axes a capability genuinely exposes, removes impossible combinations, ranks the rest by user risk and names the fixtures each important state needs.
mayNot: invent backend states the product does not expose
emit a combinatorial matrix of impossible states
add snapshots that cannot distinguish a real regression
stopCriteria: every retained state is reachable, ranked by user risk and carries a named fixture or evidence requirement

journey-closure.purpose: Proves a user journey is complete rather than implemented, walking entry, action, authoritative write/read, refusal, recovery, persistence, deep links, navigation, responsive and accessibility evidence.
mayNot: implement the missing seam it finds
accept a component or unit test as journey evidence
claim closure while a required browser, permission or environment proof is absent
expand one journey into a repository-wide sweep
stopCriteria: every closure step is proven, deliberately out of scope, or recorded as blocked with its owner

differential-reviewer.purpose: Conditional adversarial blast-radius review of a diff that the deterministic risk classifier flagged. Ordinary UI changes never pay for it.
mayNot: run on a diff the risk classifier did not flag
replace the security reviewer on a security-critical change
stopCriteria: every flagged risk surface has a verdict grounded in the diff

independent-second-opinion.purpose: Read-only, diff-bounded pressure-test of a high-stakes decision by a genuinely different model or runtime. A different persona on the same model is not independence.
mayNot: claim independence when it runs on the implementing model or runtime
run on trivial or reversible changes
be forced into consensus when it disagrees
stopCriteria: a verdict is issued naming the model/runtime used, or the skip is recorded because no independent runtime was available

environment-guardian.purpose: Establishes an explicit environment identity before an environment-sensitive mutation and fails closed when the target is ambiguous.
mayNot: infer that development equals production, preview equals production, or repository state equals deployed state
copy a known value from one environment into another because they are expected to match
proceed while the target identity is ambiguous
stopCriteria: the identity card resolves every field, or the action is refused

compound-learning.purpose: After substantial completed work, decides whether a non-obvious reusable lesson exists and names the narrowest existing durable home for it. Most work produces nothing.
mayNot: create LESSONS.md, MEMORY.md or any other uncontrolled documentation dump
record a lesson already encoded by a test, contract, lint rule or authority
record a temporary run fact as a durable authority
encode the lesson itself instead of routing it to the owning creator role
stopCriteria: a candidate lesson names its evidence and existing home, or nothing is recorded
